components.title: kyverno
components.description: Kyverno admission and background policies enforcing the mapped controls.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Cluster role bindings must not grant cluster-admin.

props.name: Check_Description
props.value: Deny RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding to the cluster-admin role.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Workloads must run as a non-root user.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Anonymous and unauthenticated subjects must not be bound to roles.

props.name: Check_Description
props.value: Deny bindings whose subjects include system:anonymous or system:unauthenticated.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Workloads must declare an audit-logging annotation so actions reach the audit trail.

props.name: Check_Description
props.value: Require the gxp.compliancefabric.io/audit-logging annotation on Pods.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Workloads must run only authentic, signed container images.

props.name: Check_Description
props.value: Verify Sigstore keyless image signatures at admission against the trusted CI identity.

control-implementations.description: Kyverno enforcement for the pharma MES baseline.

implemented-requirements.description: Admit only authentic, signed container images so the running software is validated and unaltered.
Restrict cluster access to authorised workloads via least-privilege admission policy.
Block anonymous and unauthenticated access at admission.
Require workloads to emit GMP-relevant change records to the platform audit pipeline.
Ensure secure, time-stamped audit trails are produced and retained immutably.

components.title: evidence-ledger
components.description: Append-only evidence store retaining audit records keyed to control identifiers.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Audit records must be retained in append-only, immutable storage.

props.name: Check_Description
props.value: Evidence ledger rejects mutation or deletion of stored records.

control-implementations.description: Evidence retention for the pharma MES baseline.
